proposal.observation: detected_lines.png: 10 magenta vertical ring boundaries are found (ring_count_error=0), but oblique red/green joint lines are sparse (~20 short segments over 10 rings, almost none in the left third x<1200 where the outlier map is very thin), while many blue horizontal fallback lines dominate, especially in the top/bottom rail/invert bands. initial_prompt_points.png shows only ~11 prompt centres for 10 rings and 9 of them are 'midpoint' fallbacks, with a single 'positive_slope' and one 'assume' point. segmentation_results.png shows 10 ring instances and a plausible staggered K/B/A pattern, but block boundaries drift and some blocks are mis-sized, consistent with prompt centres placed by fallback rather than by joint intersections. Incumbent measurements: correspondence_f1@15=0.322 (low vs the 0.51 staggered dev reference), sam_fill_rate=0.740 (healthy), ring_count_error=0, depth_nan_ratio=0.120 (comparable to dev 0.126), boundary_explained_edge@25=0.836, phase_incoherence=24.2 deg.
proposal.rule: d7 (stage_4_detection): m_line_yield low AND horizontal/midpoint fallback triggered -> f_missing_lines; upstream check d6 (stage_3_upsample): joint contrast low in the outlier map (sparse left third) -> f_joint_oversmoothed is a plausible contributing cause via inter_stage_dependencies (f_joint_oversmoothed -> f_missing_lines). d5 does not fire (depth_nan_ratio 0.12 is at the dev-reference level), and ring count is exact, so stage-2 gating and SAM y_bounds are left untouched.
proposal.failure_mode: stage_4_detection.f_missing_lines (too few oblique joint lines, prompt centres fall back to midpoints -> low correspondence_f1@15), with likely upstream stage_3_upsample.f_joint_oversmoothed.
proposal.rationale: Remediation r_relax_hough (lower oblique Hough threshold, raise maxLineGap) directly targets f_missing_lines; its precondition asks to first address upstream joint enhancement, which within the allowed bounds is enhancing.inter_radius (enhance_outlier_points interpolation radius) - raising it densifies joint/outlier points so faint joint lines gain pixels in the outlier map. binary_threshold is lowered slightly below the 127 default so more faint interpolated joint pixels survive binarisation. The staggered worked examples are joint outcomes, but they bound the risk: the catastrophic degrade (Example 2) coincided with unfolding/denoising/y_bounds moves, so those stages are deliberately left at incumbent values; Example 1 kept F1 and fill stable with oblique threshold 44 and maxLineGap 47, and Example 3 with the smallest inter_radius (0.022) lost F1, so the proposal moves inter_radius toward the upper range instead. Changes are moderate and all inside configs/bounds/staggered.json; unfolding is not touched because stage-1 is locked; sam.processing.y_bounds is not touched because sam_fill_rate and ring count are already healthy.
